title: A master asks a read-only investigator about an item and the answer appears on the item
description: Seeds an item with a branch head, runs `mainworks ask GY-N QUESTION` as the master against a stand-in runtime, and asserts the item's history shows the summary and file:line evidence; unparseable output and the time bound each record one failure line instead.

steps.name: the master's question is answered on the item's history
